title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 垃圾处理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）
meta: 主题语境：垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）　|　核心词汇：smog　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 smog 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the ranger ① cleared the smog that no villager in the valley would have counted, and he said the clearing was the whole of the season. The ② smog, meaning the haze itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; smog, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of smog in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ smog at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Smog, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the ranger said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the smog was the whole of the matter, meaning the harm and not the haze. The ⑥ smog, meaning the harm and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; smog, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both haze and a harm. He said the harm is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ smog had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ smog of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of counting; smog, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ smog I remember is the smog counted in the survey, which closed in 1961 and is still counted as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Smog, my mother said in 1963, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all smog, she said, is a harm that has agreed to look like haze. She said the harm was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 雾霾（指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 雾霾（指那层雾霾本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the smog 治理这一层雾霾
D. n. 雾霾（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 雾霾之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的雾霾之事）
F. n. 雾霾（指踏勘记录里写到、被清点的那一层）
G. n. 雾霾、祸患（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祸患（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the smog that no villager in the valley would have counted
The smog, meaning the haze itself and not the staff
Every sort of smog in that valley
the smog at the far ridge
the smog was the whole of the matter
the smog had become a line in a survey
The smog of the whole thing

answers.why: clear the smog 意为“治理这一层雾霾”，1954 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯清点的一层雾霾做了一遍。
smog 意为“雾霾”，指那层雾霾本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被清点。
smog 意为“雾霾”，指山谷里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
smog 意为“雾霾”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
smog 意为“雾霾、祸患”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这层祸患就是那件事的全部。
smog 意为“祸患”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那层雾霾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
smog 意为“雾霾”，指踏勘记录里写到、被清点的那一层，到 1959 年这一层成了踏勘记录里的一行。
smog 意为“雾霾之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的雾霾之事是一处山谷和三个季节的清点。
smog 意为“雾霾”，我记得的是踏勘记录里清点过的那一层，1961 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一层。
smog 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，雾霾是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的雾霾。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年那位守林人治理了山谷里没有一位村民肯清点的一层雾霾，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（clear the smog）
那层雾霾，指的是那层雾霾本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被清点。（smog）
那处山谷里每一类雾霾旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（smog）
最远那道山脊那层雾霾，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（smog）
叔叔说这层祸患就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那层雾霾。（smog）
1963 年母亲说，雾霾是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的雾霾。（smog）

Every sort of smog in that valley had the same short staff beside it.

My uncle said the smog was the whole of the matter, meaning the harm and not the haze.
